The primary manufacturers of FDA-approved Automated External Defibrillators (AEDs) include
ZOLL
Philips
Stryker (Physio-Control / HeartSine)
Defibtech
, and
Avive Solutions
. These companies produce reliable devices designed for public access, workplaces, and medical facilities, with prices generally ranging from $1,400 to $2,500+.
American AED
Major AED Manufacturers & Models
ZOLL Medical:
Known for the
ZOLL AED Plus
and
ZOLL AED 3
, featuring Real CPR Help technology that gives feedback on chest compression depth and rate.
American AED
Philips Healthcare:
Famous for the
HeartStart OnSite
(ideal for homes and light use) and
HeartStart FRx
(rugged for public spaces and sports).
Response Ready
Stryker / Physio-Control / HeartSine:
Produces the
LIFEPAK CR2
and the ultra-portable
HeartSine Samaritan PAD
series (350P, 360P, 450P).
American AED
Defibtech:
Makes the distinct yellow-and-black
Lifeline AED
and
Lifeline VIEW
, which features a full-color video display for rescue guidance.
U.S. Food and Drug Administration (.gov)
Avive Solutions:
Offers newer connected technology like the
Avive AED System
designed for modern public response networks.
U.S. Food and Drug Administration (.gov)
Cardiac Science:
Historically a standalone major brand (Powerheart series), now integrated under
ZOLL
